_readme: Inputs for priest_duel.py. 'spells' are Forever level-30 values from Wowhead unless marked. hunter/priest blocks are PLACEHOLDERS - replace with what you see in game.

hunter._hp_mana: from minmax.py's best set (sv_mm_tank). PLACEHOLDER until calibrated
hunter._auto_dps: Auto Shot DPS incl. crit/miss. ~(bow dps + RAP/14) x 1.06. PLACEHOLDER - read a dummy
hunter._hits_per_sec: Auto Shot + pet hits per second; each strips one Inner Fire charge
hunter._shot_dmg_per_mana: Aimed/Multi/Serpent are ~1.4-1.5 damage per mana at 30; Arcane Shot is ~0.8
hunter._has_dismember: Pet ability: -50% healing for 10s. Set false if your pet doesn't have it
hunter._execute_frac: 'burst' also spends mana once the priest is below this fraction of health
hunter._pet_dies_at: Second the priest kills (or permanently fears off) your pet; null = pet survives. Improved Mend Pet's job is to push this later

priest._hp_mana: PLACEHOLDER - a twink priest with Fortitude
priest._inner_fire_dr: Inner Fire +720 armor ~ -19% physical damage at 30 while charges last
priest._offense: PLACEHOLDER - priest damage while not healing (Mind Blast, SW:Pain, Smite) and its mana cost
priest._offense_mana_floor: Priest stops spending mana on damage below this fraction and wands instead
priest._mana_burn: Mana Burn drains 199-211 per 3s cast. Set true for a priest who burns you
priest._scream_pet: Priest uses Psychic Scream on your pet whenever it's off cooldown

spells._penance: Forever: 184 healing instantly and every 1s for 2s (3 ticks), 100 mana, 12s CD
spells._weakened_soul_sec: Classic value - not confirmed for Forever
spells._mend: Improved Mend Pet: 50% cleanse per heal tick (1/s) -> ~2s of fear; Mend Pet 155 mana -20%
spells._intimidation_cd: Classic value - not confirmed for Forever
